text:
ana: Kicking off the nova-2.1 catalog enable in the 09:00-11:00 PST change window. Planning a staggered variant affinity switchover across US/EU. Pin list below, need final ack on fallback ordering and rollback thresholds.

devon: ack. canary at 5% EU first, then 10% US if metrics look good. telemetry hooks enabled?

sylvia: pinging infra — telemetry is ON but we need the token-level sampling for perf traces. omar can you confirm retention + alert rules?

omar: I set samplers to 1/50 for now and increased span retention to 72h for the window. Alerts: latency P50/P95 and error-rate bumped. Will post the alert playbook link in a sec.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: nova-2.1 -> catalog-v2 on 2025-02-11T09:15:00-08:00. Canary groups: eu-canary (5%), us-canary (5%). Rollout steps queued. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/nova-rollout

kai: rollback threshold: if p95 latency > 600ms sustained for 5 min OR error-rate > 1.5% spike, trigger immediate drain and switch to fallback ladder. Is that the consensus?

sylvia: agree on p95/err thresholds. also add model-compat mismatch monitor (text truncation/regression) — we saw diffs on a recent quantized enable.

devon: fallback ordering proposal: 1) same-arch quantized variant, 2) previous pinned model (nova-2.0), 3) regional fallback to smaller model (skyline-7b), 4) global deny/503.

ana: re ordering: prefer previous pinned model before quantized when quality regressions are detected. reverse if infra degradation (latency/cpu). we need a rule split: quality-fail vs infra-fail. clearly defined.

leo: I'll update release notes and the catalog entry with the pin metadata and fallback ladder. small note — include the canary IDs so SRE can query traces directly.

omar: playbook link: https://internal/playbooks/nova-2.1-rollout (contains rollback commands and who to page). paging policy: page on automatic rollback or manual roll call.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed: infra capacity OK, model compatibility tests OK, kv-cache warmers primed. Next: canary deploy at 09:20.

ana: tagging @sylvia @devon @kai for final green. if no objections in 10m we proceed.

sylvia: green from me. will watch quality dashboards.

devon: green. I'll be on watch for latency and BLEU-ish quality checks.

kai: green. ops on-call and readiness confirmed.

ops-bot: NOTE: EU region drain window active between 09:15-09:45 for canary. Cross-region failover tests disabled during window.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started -> eu-canary group. rollout id: rlt-1745678901-1

sylvia: quick head's up — first batch shows a +0.7% decrease on response cohesion for a small prompt set A. Not catastrophic but flagging.

ana: thanks. devon, toggle canary hold? prefer to hold at 5% while we triage.

devon: holding rollout at 5%. digging into prompt set diffs now. can we widen sampling for that cohort to 1/10?

omar: increased sampling for prompt set A. sending traces to team Slack channel.

sylvia: initial root cause looks like tokenization edgecase with the new tokenizer patch in nova-2.1. patch incoming or revert? patch would take ~15-20m to build and validated.

kai: if quality regression stays >0.5% after 10m, we should roll back to nova-2.0. agree?

ana: yes. set automatic rollback timer: 10m from now if regression persists and p95 threshold also exceeded.

deploy-bot: hold enforced: rollout paused at 5%. timer set for 10 minutes for auto-rollback condition evaluation.

leo: I'll draft a short release-note addendum: "paused canary due to tokenization edgecase; investigating. No customer impact so far." to share with CS.

devon: patch building now. if tests pass we can push quantized-compatible tokenizer patch and resume within the window.

sylvia: tests passing on internal harness. recommend patch PR -> deploy patch to canary only, re-run canary samples.

deploy-bot: patch deploy scheduled: nova-2.1-tokenfix -> eu-canary at 09:38. rollout id rlt-1745678901-2

sylvia: re-run diffs: quality delta reduced to +0.1% on prompt set A. p95 stable. good to increment.

ana: increment US canary to 10%. continue ramp with telemetry. keep rollback thresholds intact.

deploy-bot: us-canary increased to 10% at 09:46. rollout id rlt-1745678901-3

omar: monitoring shows stable latency and error-rate. no pages yet.

kai: if any secondary regressions appear (generation length/prefix losses) revert ordering to previous pinned model first. we must document which signals map to which fallback in the playbook.

devon: noted. updating internal deploy checklist -> map signals to fallback steps.

leo: release-note sent to CS with current status and expected finish time 10:45 PST.

ana: thanks everyone. final check: if all green we'll finish rollout to 100% in region by 10:20 and global by 10:45 with final catalog pin to nova-2.1.

sylvia: green across our monitors. proceeding with staggered ramp.

deploy-bot: rollout completed to 100% US/EU at 10:18. final state: nova-2.1 active. catalog pin updated: nova:2.1 -> pinned. Rollout artifacts: rlt-1745678901-{1,2,3}.logs

omar: closing alerts to normal thresholds and reducing sampling back to baseline.

ana: follow-up action: create a short postmortem capture of the tokenization edgecase and add a guard in preflight test to catch it next time.

devon: will file the doc and link to the model onboarding checklist.

ops-bot: FYI — rollback window closed. If any retroactive issues, open an incident channel and tag #incidents.

leo: adding final note to the catalog entry about the canary pause and the tokenizer hotfix.

ana: great work team. :tada:
